package.description: The award-winning genealogy software which makes researching, organizing, and sharing your family history easy!

en-US.description: The award-winning genealogy software which makes researching, organizing, and sharing your family history easy!
en-US.longDescription: RootsMagic is the award-winning genealogy and family tree software designed to help users discover, document, and share their family history with ease. It allows you to start from scratch or import existing trees, integrate records from FamilySearch, Ancestry, MyHeritage, and Findmypast, and keep notes, photos, health details, and DNA matches organized in one place.
en-US.name: RootsMagic 3
